headline: Waymo has borrowed 5 billion dollars from a group of lenders for the first time, to fund the expansion of its driverless taxi service.
score_reason: Lowered from 6: the loan closed on 8 Oct 2026, before the window, though it was widely reported on 12 Oct.
importance_line: Waymo's growth is now partly funded by lenders who price its risk separately from parent Alphabet, but the loan terms and any Alphabet guarantee are not disclosed.
source: 24/7 Wall St., citing Waymo and Bloomberg
summary: 24/7 Wall St. reports, citing Waymo's announcement and Bloomberg, that Waymo, the driverless taxi unit of Alphabet, closed a 5 billion dollar term loan on 8 Oct 2026, its first debt financing, led by PIMCO, Blackstone and Sixth Street. Waymo did not disclose the repayment date or exact rate, and the outlet notes that it is unclear whether Alphabet guarantees the loan.
notes: Pool link was Konsulteer (copy site); read 24/7 Wall St. and FintechNews CH instead.
